description: Ecwid (Lightspeed) offers a REST API, webhooks and apps for managing store data.
auth_notes: Custom apps get a secret access token sent as a Bearer token; public apps use OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow returning an access token.
gate_detail: After signing up and getting a custom app, secret and public tokens are available immediately. Public apps need App Market registration. A test store is suggested for development; plan requirements not stated.
api_scope: REST API to access and manage store data, payment and shipping methods, and storefront settings, including orders, products, categories, customers and discounts.
mcp_notes: No MCP server is mentioned in the sources.
blocker_detail: Custom-app tokens are self-serve; public apps listed on the App Market involve a registration process.

evidence.quote: Ecwid REST API allows you to access and manage any store data, payment and shipping methods, and storefront settings.
Ecwid uses OAuth 2.0 to provide secure access to the store data for public apps.
After signing up with Ecwid and getting a custom app, you already have two tokens
your secret access token as a Bearer Token on the Authorization tab
Build automated business processes or sync the store data with an external service.
you can safely experiment and develop without impacting your live store and its data.

uncertainties: Free-plan availability for API access is not directly stated.
Test store wording is truncated in the source.
No MCP information in the sources.
